name: deep-caves
title: Cruel Rain
author: OpenAI + Gannon
description: Descend beneath a hostile, rain-soaked wasteland into five cave layers. Narrow tunnels, ore caverns, white cave creatures, flooded depths, configurable pollution vents, ramp cargo, pipe-connected fluids, cross-level power, and solid rock walls. Configurable research and rocket costs; optional surface-only silos. All cave and weather systems included.
